rounds.ai_message: Hi Chen, this is Linda from our QC team. We received the shipment yesterday and found a quality concern on PO 2024-512. Can we talk?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈,你好,我是 QC 部的 Linda。PO 2024-512 的货昨天到了,我们发现一个质量问题,能聊聊吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 认真接收、表达关切,不要急着辩解
key_phrases: Could you share the details and photos?
rounds.common_mistakes: 客户刚说 'quality concern',不要马上说 'this never happened before'。先听,后问证据。
rounds.tips_zh: 接收投诉三步:acknowledge / ask for evidence / commit to follow up。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Linda, I'm sorry to hear that. Could you share the specific issue and some photos? We take every quality concern seriously and will look into it right away.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. The shipment arrived with broken stitches on about 8 percent of the garments — mostly on the side seam. The packing list says 3,000 pieces, so that's roughly 240 pieces affected.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。货到的时候大约 8% 的衣服有车缝开线的问题,主要在侧缝。装箱单是 3000 件,大概 240 件受影响。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 先确认 + 请客户发证据 + 表明会查
key_phrases: Could you send photos and the inspection report?
We will check our QC records
8 percent is above the acceptable AQL
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要立刻 'agree' 客户的数据(8%),先要 inspection report,再去查自己 QC 记录。
rounds.tips_zh: AQL 2.5 = 接受水准 4% 以下;8% 远超,确实要赔。
rounds.user_response_example: Thank you for the details. Could you send me photos and the third-party inspection report? I will check our in-line QC and final inspection records against your findings.

rounds.ai_message: The report and photos are attached. What is your proposed solution?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 报告和照片附上了。你们打算怎么处理?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给具体方案(选项),不要空话
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要只说 'we will handle it'。给客户选:返工(rework)、补货(replacement)、折扣(discount)。
rounds.tips_zh: 三方共赢:工厂成本最小、客户损失最小、关系不伤。三选一是行业惯例。
rounds.user_response_example: We can offer three options for the 240 affected pieces: (1) we rework and return them within 10 days at our cost, (2) we remake and resend within 15 days, or (3) we issue a 30 percent credit note for replacement. Your call.

rounds.ai_message: The buyer is asking for a discount, not rework — they need the goods on shelf by next Friday. Can you issue a credit note?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 客户要折扣,不要返工 — 他们下周五前要上架。能开扣款单吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认能开 credit note / debit note,讲清流程
key_phrases: Yes, we can issue a credit note
Please send the debit note format
Credit will be applied to the next order
rounds.common_mistakes: credit note(供应商开,贷记客户账)和 debit note(客户开,索赔扣款)别搞反,方向不同。
rounds.tips_zh: 大客户走 debit note 走流程;小客户直接 credit note 更简单。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, we can issue a credit note. Please send your debit note format with the exact value, and we will counter-sign and apply it to your next PO. What amount are we looking at?

rounds.ai_message: The buyer proposes a 25 percent credit. Can you accept that, plus a root-cause analysis report within one week?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 客户提 25% 折扣,加一份一周内的根因分析报告,你们能接受吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 折扣可以谈(给个台阶),RCA 报告必须配合
key_phrases: RCA report will be delivered within 5 business days
We will improve our final inspection
rounds.common_mistakes: RCA(Root Cause Analysis)报告不仅找原因,更要写 corrective action 和 prevention measure,光说 '我们注意' 不算 RCA。
rounds.tips_zh: RCA 标准结构:problem / 5-why analysis / root cause / corrective action / prevention / timeline / owner。
rounds.user_response_example: We accept the 25 percent credit. For the RCA, you will have it within 5 business days, including the 5-why analysis, our corrective action, and the prevention plan. We will also strengthen the final inspection.
